main_body: A wooden chair seen in side profile: a tall backrest on the left, an L-shaped seat extending to the right, and dark legs below.
top_band: none. The seat is a thin lighter strip, about 2-3 rows (rows ~9-11), tapering into the backrest, and reads as a profile edge rather than a surface seen from above.
evidence: The drawing is a side-profile chair silhouette like the red 'side elevation chair' in the guide. The tall back is a vertical strip on the left, and the seat is a short block with only a thin lighter edge on top. It has no distinct top band, front-edge line or eave shadow, so no horizontal seat surface can be read from above. The legs are thin dark posts below. The seat is a thin band of about 2 rows, not the 5-row top of the correct seat in the guide.

style.evidence: The chair has about 3 tones of orange-brown wood (light edge, mid, shadow) and a dark brown outline tinted toward the wood, which is acceptable. The backrest and seat are mostly flat fills with no grain or texture dots. Beside the stall and well references, which have 5-6 steps and rich texture, it is clearly thinner and has fewer colours per tile.
